user.title: Rumlys
user.description: Rumlys brings the light in each room together: motion, turn-off times, «keep light on», periods of the day and scenes. Once the integration is set up, add rooms with «Add room» and set them up in Rumlys in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Rumlys is already set up. Add rooms under the integration.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Choose the area. The room takes the area's name, and the area's lights and sensors are selected in advance. The rest is set up in Rumlys in the sidebar.

reconfigure.title: Edit {navn}
reconfigure.description: Lights, light, the day and times are edited in [Rumlys in the sidebar]({sti}). Here the room can be moved to another area.

abort.ingen_omraader: Every area already has a room. Create a new area in Home Assistant first.
